$comment: Mission 1.43 §1, §3, §5, §7. The PREREGISTERED plan: the gap matrix, the routes considered, the one selected, and the target structure -- all frozen BEFORE any derivation ran. This is a PREPARATION artifact in the Mission 1.36 / 1.42 sense: it records the question and the plan as they stood beforehand, and it must not be rewritten once the outcome is known. What actually happened is recorded separately.

ordering_disclosure.$note: §12 requires the convergence contract to be defined before results are inspected. §0 requires the live corpus to be MEASURED first. Both were honoured, and the overlap is disclosed rather than glossed.
ordering_disclosure.what_was_measured_first: The §0 baseline, which necessarily includes how many Claims each source and proposition kind holds and how their directions are distributed. That is existing corpus state, not the result of this mission's derivation.
ordering_disclosure.why_it_does_not_taint_the_contract: The identity/witness classification below follows from the ADR-035 test applied to FACT NAMES -- does changing this field change WHAT is asserted, or only WHICH observation witnesses it -- and does not depend on how many rows carry each value. The same classification would be written if every article had exactly one day-pair, in which case the contract would simply yield no multi-Evidence Claim and the mission would report PREREGISTERED_CORPUS_SHAPE_NOT_OBSERVED.

the_algebraic_finding.$note: Measured across all 37 live Claims, and the reason this mission is not primarily about adding rows.
the_algebraic_finding.statement: With exactly ONE support group, the full aggregator is not merely empirically equal to the Mission 1.37 B-2 reliability pass-through baseline -- it is ALGEBRAICALLY identical to it. Saturation computes S = 1 - prod(1 - g) over groups, which for a single group is that group's strength; group strength is max(members); and B-2 is the reliability-limited strongest item, which is the same max over the same q values.
the_algebraic_finding.consequence: No amount of additional single-group Evidence can ever make the two differ. The aggregation layer becomes measurable only when a Claim carries MORE THAN ONE provenance group -- which requires ESTABLISHED independence -- or when contradiction opens the contradiction side of the mass decomposition.
the_algebraic_finding.why_this_reframes_corpus_expansion: Adding rows of the shapes the corpus already has increases volume and cannot increase calibration information. The load-bearing missing shapes are independence and contradiction, and both are blocked by facts about provenance rather than by effort.

gap_matrix.$note: CALIBRATION_VALUE is qualitative and its four values are defined here rather than assumed. No numeric importance score is assigned anywhere.

calibration_value_definitions.CRITICAL: Without it, an aggregation mechanism cannot be exercised AT ALL, so no parameter governing it can be evaluated.
calibration_value_definitions.HIGH: The mechanism runs but over a degenerate case, so its parameters have no observable effect.
calibration_value_definitions.USEFUL: Adds variation to something already exercised.
calibration_value_definitions.LOW: Adds volume to a shape already represented.

dimensions.current_examples: none; every Evidence row in the corpus is independence_state UNKNOWN, and 0 EvidenceIndependenceGroups exist
dimensions.missing_shape: one Claim whose supporting Evidence forms two or more groups of ESTABLISHED independence, so saturation combines them and multi_source_min_groups has an observable effect
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: two sources measuring the SAME proposition through demonstrably different data generation. No pair of registered sources currently does: each measures a different quantity, so this is blocked by what the portfolio observes rather than by governance.

dimensions.current_examples: none; all 39 Evidence rows are SUPPORTS
dimensions.missing_shape: Evidence bearing AGAINST the exact same bounded proposition, so contradicted_mass and conflict_mass stop being their c = 0 values
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: requires two measurements of ONE proposition that disagree. Every current proposition kind embeds its own measurement identity, so a second measurement of the same proposition does not exist. A decrease does not contradict an increase: under the detailed kinds direction is part of proposition identity, and under an existential a counterexample does not falsify.

dimensions.missing_shape: already present at CLAIM level; absent at MULTI-EVIDENCE level, where only public_procurement appears
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: a convergence contract for a second source family's proposition kind, from Signals already held

dimensions.current_examples: two TED convergent Claims, two Evidence each
dimensions.missing_shape: multi-Evidence outside one source, one proposition kind and one reliability scope; and any Claim with more than two witnesses, so group cardinality varies at all
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: existing Wikimedia Signals, via a convergence contract

dimensions.missing_shape: a second kind that supports convergence; today exactly one does
a Claim whose truth condition decays, so freshness has anything to act on
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: NONE from the OBSERVED layer. Every OBSERVED restatement is a historical fact about what a source published, and a historical fact does not decay. Temporal sensitivity belongs to the INFERRED layer, which is deliberately unbuilt.

dimensions.missing_shape: follows TEMPORALITY exactly; a claim_feature without a temporally sensitive Claim governs nothing
variation WITHIN one Claim. Reliability is scope-level, and every Evidence row on a Claim shares a scope, so within-Claim q is constant by construction and max(members) has nothing to choose between.
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: only a Claim whose Evidence spans two reliability scopes, which requires two sources supporting one proposition -- the same blocker as ESTABLISHED_INDEPENDENCE

dimensions.current_examples: identical to the reliability values, because reliability limits 28 of 28 scorable Claims
dimensions.missing_shape: a Claim where something OTHER than reliability is the limiting component
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: relevance, directness and extraction confidence are 1.0 on every row by construction of the deterministic interpreters. §26 forbids altering them, so this cannot be created without a genuinely partial interpretation.

dimensions.current_examples: developer tooling, public procurement, encyclopedia readership, official statistics, news corpus
dimensions.missing_shape: a consumer, education or creator domain
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: every such source is GOVERNANCE_BLOCKED at the eligibility gate under local-private-research-v1

dimensions.current_examples: PRODUCT for Docker-family subjects, CATEGORY for the TED CPV division, UNDETERMINED for GDELT terms
dimensions.missing_shape: MARKET scope, which no registered source observes
dimensions.possible_real_source_route: none; Mission 1.34 recorded that MARKET's example in this repository is literally none

live_governance.$note: §2. Read from the LIVE deployment under local-private-research-v1, not from an earlier report. Condition satisfaction is per-deployment verification state, which is why a source whose collector has run in the past can be blocked now.
live_governance.consequence_for_this_mission: Any route needing a NETWORK ACQUISITION from Wikimedia, Stack Exchange, GDELT or OpenAlex is blocked today. The selected route needs none: it re-derives from Signals already lawfully collected, and re-interpretation of held records exercises no acquisition authorization.

candidate_routes.proposition_kind: a NEW convergent kind projected from platform_counted_content_request_change
candidate_routes.possible_multi_evidence_shape: an existential over day-pairs: several day-over-day changes in one direction for one article each witness one broader proposition. 18 held Signals across 3 articles and 2 directions.
candidate_routes.possible_contradiction_shape: NONE. A decrease does not contradict an existential about increases; it witnesses a different proposition.
candidate_routes.possible_independence_shape: NONE. Every witness comes from one publisher, one pipeline and one documented counting method.
candidate_routes.published_taxonomy_or_scope_basis: the platform's own article identifier and its own requester class
candidate_routes.reliability_status: NO_RELIABILITY_SCOPE_YET for the new kind; the existing 0.65 binds the DETAILED kind and must not be widened
candidate_routes.expected_calibration_information_value: HIGH for structure: second source family, second convergence-capable kind, second measurement mechanism, and the first Claims with MORE THAN TWO witnesses. LOW for numbers, because it will be NON_SCORABLE until a reviewer looks at the new scope.
candidate_routes.engineering_work_required: one convergence contract entry, and generalising the convergent interpreter's single hard-wired projection pair into a route table

candidate_routes.reliability_status: APPLICABLE_RELIABILITY at 0.55, so it would be scorable
candidate_routes.expected_calibration_information_value: LOW. It would be scorable, which is tempting, and it repeats the same proposition kind, reliability scope, UNKNOWN provenance grouping, q limiter and EVERGREEN semantics. By the algebraic finding it cannot make the aggregator differ from pass-through.

candidate_routes.possible_multi_evidence_shape: an existential over period-pairs, structurally the same move as Wikimedia
candidate_routes.published_taxonomy_or_scope_basis: the publisher's indicator and geography codes
candidate_routes.reliability_status: NO_RELIABILITY_SCOPE_YET; World Bank has no assessment at all
candidate_routes.expected_calibration_information_value: comparable to Wikimedia in kind, lower in degree: only 4 held Signals across 4 Claims, so fewer witnesses per proposition and no Claim with more than two.

candidate_routes.possible_multi_evidence_shape: would need a second bounded query over a different window, which is an acquisition
candidate_routes.reliability_status: the operator reviewed both Stack Exchange scopes and answered NO, so no assessment exists and none should be sought
candidate_routes.governance_status: GOVERNANCE_BLOCKED for acquisition: three conditions unsatisfied in this deployment

candidate_routes.temporality: EVERGREEN, and H-29 leaves the bucket timezone unestablished
candidate_routes.possible_multi_evidence_shape: possible in principle over adjacent buckets
candidate_routes.published_taxonomy_or_scope_basis: none; a term names no level of thing, and its ObservationScope is UNDETERMINED
candidate_routes.expected_calibration_information_value: low; only 3 held Evidence rows and the weakest epistemic footing in the corpus

candidate_routes.possible_independence_shape: in principle the most interesting in the catalog -- a second statistical agency publishing a series about the same subject as World Bank would be the portfolio's only candidate for ESTABLISHED independence
candidate_routes.governance_status: eligible at source level, but NO CONCRETE RESOURCE IS AUTHORISED and no collector exists
candidate_routes.expected_calibration_information_value: potentially CRITICAL, because it is the one visible route to a second provenance group
candidate_routes.engineering_work_required: resource authorisation, a collector, a normalizer, an extractor -- several missions

selection.primary_route: wikimedia-pageviews convergent existential over day-pairs, from Signals already held
selection.secondary_route_rationale: §6 permits a second route only if the first cannot address more than one high-priority shape AND the second is nearly free. Neither holds: World Bank would add the same structural shape with fewer witnesses, and adding it would double the contract work for no new mechanism.
why_selected: It is the only route that exercises a mechanism the corpus has never exercised -- group cardinality above two -- without any acquisition.
It adds a second source family, a second convergence-capable proposition kind and a second measurement mechanism to the multi-Evidence shape, which today is entirely one TED kind.
It requires ZERO network calls, which matters beyond efficiency: Wikimedia acquisition is currently blocked by three unsatisfied conditions, so re-derivation is the only open door.
It reuses Mission 1.39's convergence machinery unchanged rather than widening the ontology.
selection.why_not_the_scorable_option: Another TED division would be immediately scorable and would teach nothing: by the algebraic finding above, a second single-group Claim cannot make the aggregator differ from the pass-through baseline. §4 and §25 both point away from it, and choosing it because the number would appear is choosing the appearance of progress.

preregistered_target.$note: §7. Semantic, not a row count. Frozen before any derivation.
preregistered_target.TARGET_A: at least one real Claim carrying two or more Evidence rows, from a source family other than public procurement, under a proposition kind that does not exist in the corpus today
preregistered_target.TARGET_B: at least one real Claim carrying MORE THAN TWO Evidence rows, so max(members) receives a group larger than any the corpus has ever formed
not_targeted: contradiction -- §8; no legitimate contradiction of the same proposition is reachable, and the counter stays 0
established independence -- §9; every witness shares publisher, pipeline and method, so UNKNOWN remains correct and 0 groups are created
temporality -- §10; an OBSERVED restatement of what a source published is a historical fact and does not decay, so converting one would be populating a counter
a reliability value -- §15, §17; the new kind is a new scope and no assessment will be created
preregistered_target.expected_secondary_outcome: NEW_CORPUS_SHAPE_NON_SCORABLE_MISSING_RELIABILITY, because the new proposition kind has no reviewed reliability and none may be invented or copied
preregistered_target.failure_condition: If the contract yields no Claim with two or more witnesses, the outcome is PREREGISTERED_CORPUS_SHAPE_NOT_OBSERVED and the contract stays as written rather than being loosened until something converges.

bounds.$note: §18, §19. There is no acquisition, so the bounds are on what may be re-derived.
bounds.network_acquisition_reason: Every input already exists: 21 Wikimedia RawRecords, their NormalizedRecords, and 18 derived Signals. §20 requires deterministic reprocessing where existing material suffices, and it does.
bounds.inputs: the existing platform_counted_content_request_change Signals and nothing else
bounds.procedure: the existing claim interpretation runtime, with one new convergence contract
may_not: modify any existing Claim, revision or Evidence row
